original_source_identity.source_scope: Paths and process IDs are historical identity evidence; replay never resolves or reads them.

method.arithmetic: Saved float32 values promoted to Python float; reductions use math.fsum.
method.checkpoint_layout: Captured little-endian v2, 64-bit size_t and step counters; full payload checked.
method.deposit_volume: Bulk event-deposit volume includes pore space; peak deposition is cumulative through day 12.
method.deposited_mass: Cumulative mineral mass from deposition sources in the complete checkpoint; excludes pore space and is not the raster bulk-deposit volume.
method.difference: Candidate minus baseline250 (concentration_scale 0.001); percentage denominator is baseline250.
method.field_domain: identical physical floodplain cells, including dry cells; fixed within-flood channel mask
method.normalization: Gross prescribed upstream input for one sinusoidal flood, using the actual C and concentration_scale of each case; excludes recycling, outlet flux, and signed bed forcing. This is not the checkpoint net external ledger.
method.post_remap: Retained remap-ledger residuals; checkpoint payload checked for layout, clocks, parameter signature, finite state, and nonnegative inventories. Physical inventory balances are not independently reconstructed here.
method.snapshot_phase: peak is day 12; end is day 20 before migration/aggradation; checkpoint is after remap
method.storage_bounds: Conservative float32 half-ULP storage bounds only; exclude discretization, separate float64 arithmetic error, and CSV rounding.

scope: Completed first-flood sediment-concentration sensitivity only; no grid or temporal convergence, 580-flood behavior, or manuscript-panel assessment.
